scripts.start: concurrently -n "admin-backend,admin-frontend,client-backend,client-frontend" -c "blue,cyan,green,yellow" "npm run dev -w admin-backend" "npm run dev -w admin-frontend" "npm run dev -w client-backend" "npm run dev -w client-frontend"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "admin-backend,admin-frontend,client-backend,client-frontend" -c "blue,cyan,green,yellow" "npm run dev -w admin-backend" "npm run dev -w admin-frontend" "npm run dev -w client-backend" "npm run dev -w client-frontend"
scripts.start:admin: concurrently -n "admin-backend,admin-frontend" -c "blue,cyan" "npm run dev -w admin-backend" "npm run dev -w admin-frontend"
scripts.dev:admin: concurrently -n "admin-backend,admin-frontend" -c "blue,cyan" "npm run dev -w admin-backend" "npm run dev -w admin-frontend"
scripts.start:client: concurrently -n "client-backend,client-frontend" -c "green,yellow" "npm run dev -w client-backend" "npm run dev -w client-frontend"
scripts.dev:client: concurrently -n "client-backend,client-frontend" -c "green,yellow" "npm run dev -w client-backend" "npm run dev -w client-frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w admin-backend && npm run build -w admin-frontend && npm run build -w client-backend && npm run build -w client-frontend
scripts.build:admin: npm run build -w admin-backend && npm run build -w admin-frontend
scripts.build:client: npm run build -w client-backend && npm run build -w client-frontend
